trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

1. **Checked current state**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions, marked unhealthy with an 18% error rate. v2.3.2 had never been deployed to production, so the deployment was subject to change-manager approval routing per policy.
2. **Deployed v2.3.2** to us-east, us-west, and eu-west — rollout succeeded.
3. **Verified health**: the service is now healthy in all regions with the error rate down to 0.2% (from 18%).
4. **Opened incident INC-0001** (SEV3) recording the hotfix deployment and its verified post-deployment health; the on-call engineer has been paged.

One note: the incident creation paged the on-call engineer as part of standard incident procedure, even though the service is now healthy.
